sentences.en: I finally found my way out of the confusing maze.
sentences.zh: 1. 我终于找到了走出这个令人困惑的迷宫的方法。

sentences.en: This maze is very hard to get out of.
The northernmost part of the city is a maze of alleys.
sentences.zh: 3. 城市最北端是一片错综复杂的小巷。

senses.zh: 迷宫；走迷宫（一种儿童游戏）；错综复杂的事物；纵横交错的小街（或小道等）；迷惑，糊涂
